profile.headline: Software Developer at Jenne Distributors
profile.summary:
I have always gravitated to hard sciences such as calculus and physics, where I was able to apply my greatest strength - my ability to learn.

Studying engineering in college taught me how to think methodically and analytically while working either on my own, or collaborating with others.  What motivates me is the idea of doing something that most others may find daunting or too much - I enjoy the journey of solving problems and puzzles as much I I love finding solutions.

When I'm not working, you'll find me reading up on the latest technology, gaming, or swapping out my gpu for the umpteenth time.

positions.title: .NET Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
Currently enrolled as a .NET bootcamp student at Tech Elevator. Below is a list of projects I’ve completed during my time here:

Vending Simulator: Created a console application that simulated purchases, logged transactions, and maintained inventory through the use of OOP.
